quarterly_data.signal: onsemi's 10-K: multi-year customer contracts with committed amounts (Long-term Supply Agreements, LTSAs) carried remaining performance obligations of approximately $7.1 billion as of December 31, 2025, of which approximately 34% is expected to be recognized as revenue in the next 12 months; during 2025 certain LTSAs were modified in response to changes in demand, primarily delivery schedules and volume. Some LTSAs include non-cancelable customer capacity payments that reserve production availability; $126.1 million (2025) and $110.9 million (2024) were recognized as revenue for satisfying the associated performance obligations. onsemi paid $341.2 million for capital expenditures in 2025 (approximately 6% of revenue) and expects 2026 capital expenditures of approximately 5% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: LTSA remaining performance obligations ~$7.1 billion (December 31, 2025), ~34% in next 12 months; capacity-payment revenue $126.1 million (2025) vs $110.9 million (2024); capex $341.2 million (2025, ~6% of revenue); 2026 capex ~5% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: All of onsemi's manufacturing facilities are owned and operated by onsemi except its assembly and test facility in Leshan, China, owned by Leshan-Phoenix Semiconductor Company Limited, a joint venture in which onsemi holds 80% (partner: Leshan Radio Company Ltd.). onsemi purchased 80% of Leshan's production capacity in each of 2025, 2024 and 2023 and is committed to purchase approximately 80% of Leshan's expected production capacity in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 80% of Leshan JV production capacity purchased (2025, 2024, 2023); ~80% committed for 2026
